name: GoF-based Dynamic 3DGS Video Construction
definition: A method to construct dynamic 3DGS video by temporally segmenting input sequences into Groups of Frames (GoFs) and independently constructing Gaussian deformation fields within each GoF to limit motion degree and prevent long-range temporal drift.
summary: GoF-based Dynamic 3DGS Video Construction segments video into short groups to train independent deformation fields, preventing motion drift and decoupling static and dynamic components.
